title: Dimension dependence and dimension-free $\ell^2$ estimates for variation seminorms of spherical means on the hypercube
summary: We prove that the $\ell^2 \to \ell^2$ norm of the $r$-variation seminorm of spherical means on the hypercube admits no dimension-free bounds for any $r \in [1, \infty)$ when the variation is taken over all possible radii. Furthermore, we establish that if the radii are restricted to a fixed parity, dimension-free estimates hold for all $r \in (2, \infty)$.
